limitations: Synthetic offline experiment only; all 240 orders are known before planning.
Distance is a 2D Manhattan nearest-neighbor proxy, not a real 3D warehouse path.
The proxy excludes CTU trajectories, dynamic obstacles, deadlock avoidance, lifts, conveyors and travel time.
The greedy method is deterministic but not guaranteed to find a global optimum.
Results are not eligible as formal real-warehouse acceptance metrics.
